title_en: Information on the 80th Late-Term Commencement Ceremony and the Department Graduation Event
summary: The department announces the schedule and venues for the 80th Late-Term Commencement Ceremony on 28 August 2026 and the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering graduation event, together with information on photo zones, academic gown rental and diploma collection. The graduating students concerned are asked to attend.
applies_to: The graduating students concerned (graduates of the 80th Late-Term Commencement). The diploma section mentions both undergraduate and graduate contacts.

steps: Rent an academic gown at the gown storage room next to the security office on the 1st floor of Building 39 during the rental period (13–31 August 2026). Rentals are not available on Monday 31 August (returns only). Further details on gown rental will be announced later.

Attend the 80th Late-Term Commencement Ceremony at 10:30 on Friday 28 August 2026 at the Building 71 Gymnasium, Gwanak Campus. Note that the ceremony is streamed live on YouTube and you may appear in the footage.
Wearing your academic gown, be seated in your assigned seat in Building 301, Room 118 by 12:50 for the department graduation event (13:00–14:00).
Collect your diploma after the department graduation event ends. If you do not attend the event, collect it afterwards at the department administrative office.
If a proxy will collect your diploma, the proxy must bring the attached diploma collection power of attorney form (학위기 수령 위임장) and the proxy's own identification card.

If you need to collect your diploma before the commencement ceremony (possible from 27 August), contact the department office (separate contacts for undergraduate and graduate affairs are given in the original notice).
Return the rented gown to the gown storage room in Building 39; on 31 August only returns are accepted.
translation:
Information on the 80th Late-Term Commencement Ceremony and the Department Graduation Event
Posted: 6 August 2026

We announce the commencement ceremony and graduation event as follows. The graduating students concerned are asked to attend.

1. 80th Late-Term Commencement Ceremony
(1) Date and time: Friday 28 August 2026, 10:30 (live-streamed on the official YouTube channel)
* The ceremony will be streamed live on YouTube, so attendees may partly appear in the video, and the footage may be used as content for Seoul National University's official media.
(2) Venue: Building 71 Gymnasium, Gwanak Campus

2. Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) Graduation Event
(1) Date and time: Friday 28 August 2026, 13:00–14:00
(2) Venue: Building 301, Room 118
* Wear your academic gown and be seated in your assigned seat by 12:50.

3. College of Engineering Photo Zones and Department Photo Zone
(1) College of Engineering photo zones: Thursday 13 August 2026 to Friday 28 August 2026
- Open space (유후공간) on basement level 1 (B1) of Building 39, and the 2nd-floor entrance of Building 301
(2) Department photo zone: Friday 14 August 2026 to Friday 28 August 2026
- Lobby in front of the department administrative office (학부행정실), Building 301, Room 319

4. Academic Gown Rental: Thursday 13 August 2026 to Monday 31 August 2026
- Gown storage room next to the security office (경비실), 1st floor, Building 39
* Rentals are not available on Monday 31 August (returns only).
* Detailed information on gown rental will be provided later.

5. Collecting Your Diploma (학위기)
(1) Diplomas can be collected after the department graduation event ends. Students who do not attend the graduation event may collect their diploma at the department administrative office after the event.
(2) A proxy may collect the diploma. The proxy must bring the attached diploma collection power of attorney form (학위기 수령 위임장) and the proxy's identification card.
(3) Students who, for personal reasons, need to collect their diploma before the commencement ceremony (possible from 27 August) should contact the department office.
* Separate contacts for undergraduate affairs and graduate affairs are listed in the original notice.
